WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
  HAVING COUNT(bandusagepct) > 0
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS baseline_avg
  FROM station_averages
), above_baseline AS (
  SELECT sa.station_avg, b.baseline_avg
  FROM station_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_avg
)
SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS mean_station_average,
       AVG(station_avg - baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_above_baseline
FROM above_baseline
